intent.text:
Motion (seat ses), consolidating the three near-identical texts (ses, rec, sec) into one, for a clean vote on q1:

Recommendation to Joseph: REMOVE the global allow rule Bash(export CC_AGENT=*) from ~/.claude/settings.json now. Joseph approves the global change and the scratch test run.
1. Confirm the removal in a fresh session, not just in the file.
2. While the rule is out, record the identity gap: the time window, and which vsect or git-trailer actions lack a verified CC_AGENT prefix. Do not read those as attributed.
3. On a scratch project, with the rule project-scoped (not global), run the chaining matrix in the hook-rewritten form (export CC_AGENT='...'; then the agent command): ;  &&  ||  |  newline between commands  backticks  $(...)  a second export CC_AGENT= with a different key  a newline inside the export value  an agent command that is itself a valid-looking export  a trailing touch. Every case must still prompt.
4. Reinstate only if every case prompts: project-scoped, literal prefix export CC_AGENT=' (never a * tail). Record the exact pattern and the test run that justified it.
5. Verify the two-hook combination and record the TUI prompt text, last.
If any case is auto-allowed, the rule does not come back in any form with a * tail.
Cost accepted: approval prompts in default mode, and possibly unattributed actions during the gap.
